content.body:
BASIC INFORMATION
.HC: Displays online HC members and OICS, as well as their brigade assignments. .HCLIST: Displays the names of all HC members online, including OIC's. .HELP: Displays list of all text commands available to a player. (Also .H). .HELP (COMMAND): Provides limited in-game assistance with text commands .HOME: Displays your brigade home. .LISTOICS: Displays a list of current OIC assignments. .NOWHO: Hides you from .who functions. .REPORT (TEXT): Sends text to CRS and GMs. For use when suspected Cheating, Griefing, or terrain anomolies are found. .SYSMOTD: View the system message of the day. .TIME: Diplays local and game server time. .TRAINERS: List any trainers currently available. .WHO (PLAYER): Displays the Persona, Rank and Brigade of the named player. .WTF: Random messages that generally lead one to say "wtf?".
AIRCRAFT
.CONV (METERS): Sets the Convergance distance of your aircraft's guns.
content.title: Basic Commands
